guardrails.title: Engine State Authority
guardrails.rule: All authoritative state lives exclusively in packages/game and is JSON-serializable.
forbidden: Persist derived caches/computed fields in state

guardrails.title: Engine-only Rule Execution
guardrails.rule: Rule execution (legality, costs, majority, modifiers, production) occurs only in packages/game.

guardrails.title: Determinism Contract
guardrails.rule: Identical move sequence produces identical state hash; RNG seeded at game start; canonical shuffle.

guardrails.title: Single Legal Action Interface
guardrails.rule: Legal actions enumerated only via enumerateLegalIntents(G, ctx, playerID); enumeration is pure.

guardrails.title: No Phantom Moves
guardrails.rule: Do not introduce intents/moves not defined by rules (e.g., pass) unless explicitly specified.

guardrails.title: Pending Choice Gate
guardrails.rule: If pendingChoice exists, only ResolveChoice intents are legal.

guardrails.title: Effect CPU Resolution Order
guardrails.rule: Resolve effects in order: Prohibition -> Cost -> Payment -> Output modifiers -> Mutation.

guardrails.title: No Implicit Effects
guardrails.rule: No implicit triggers/hidden state/unstated stacking. Only explicit spec text.

guardrails.title: Zone Invariants
guardrails.rule: Every object exists in exactly one zone; expansions have isolated zones; no mixing unless explicit.

guardrails.title: Start Committee Immunity & Targeting
guardrails.rule: Start Committee is immune, not controllable; no Influence placement on it.

guardrails.title: Production Canon
guardrails.rule: Production must follow CORE-01-06-16 and canonical sweep order.

guardrails.title: Match Config is Canonical
guardrails.rule: Single read-only match config (e.g., G.cfg) is the sole authority for expansion enablement; guard mismatches.
forbidden: Derive enabled expansions from arbitrary state slices

guardrails.title: Bot Contract
guardrails.rule: Bot selects only from enumerateLegalIntents; no bypass; no engine introspection.

guardrails.title: UI Iconography Stability
guardrails.rule: Tile-type to icon mapping is treated as stable presentation contract.
